lines.zh: 两步之后，我停下来贴墙听。
lines.en: Two steps, then I press to the wall and listen.
A hallway this long is perfect for a chase.
Ball of the foot first, pressing the sound down.

lines.zh: 门缝底下有光，家里有人。
lines.en: Light under the door — someone's home.

lines.zh: 木地板在我脚下吱了一声。
lines.en: The wood creaks once under my foot.
That rustle in the grass is me.

lines.zh: 地砖一块块数过去，八块。
lines.en: I count the floor tiles: eight of them.

lines.zh: 脚尖先落地，再放下脚跟。
lines.en: Toes first, then the heel.
Seven steps. I count them clearly.
My shadow climbs the door panel first.

lines.zh: 门外只有风，我走了两步。
lines.en: Only wind at the door. I take two steps.

lines.zh: 我们一群跑起来，草就全倒了。
lines.en: When our pack runs, the grass falls flat.

lines.zh: 烛火歪了，墙上的影子也歪。
lines.en: The candle leans, and so does my shadow.

lines.zh: 墙角的灰，比我记得的厚。
lines.en: The dust in the corner is thicker than I recall.
Something moves inside this wall.
I crouch, but my shadow stays standing.
I remember the mole on your left cheek.
This room has been watching me
A sliver of white still shows through the paper.
I counted to fifteen and there you were.
I'll stay behind the door. No trouble.
I haven't moved since you left.

lines.zh: 门框还在，门不知去哪了。
lines.en: The frame remains. The door is gone.
Those steps upstairs aren't mine.

lines.zh: 被子鼓着，可没有翻身声。
lines.en: The blanket's lumped, but there's no turning.

lines.zh: 我叫什么，我自己也忘了。
lines.en: Even I forget what I'm called.

lines.zh: 你身上有熟悉的味道，像母亲。
lines.en: You smell familiar, like my mother.

lines.zh: 脖子转过来，我就看清了。
lines.en: Turn your neck this way and I'll see clearly.
I hide in the corner and watch you shake.
Your eyes flicked over. Don't hide it.

lines.zh: 上回你也是站在这格地砖。
lines.en: Last time you stood on this same tile.

lines.zh: 野生的幼体，闻得到你的火。
lines.en: The feral young can smell your torch.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，这张脸有两张嘴。
lines.en: Head tilted, this face has two mouths.

lines.zh: 你看着我，我看着你的喉咙。
lines.en: You watch me, I watch your throat.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴，从胸口就开始张。
lines.en: My mouth starts opening from my chest.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼神，你记住了。
lines.en: You'll remember how I looked at you.
You clench your fist till the knuckles pale.

lines.zh: 野生的这张脸，还没长开。
lines.en: This feral face has not filled out yet.
You turned your head — good.
I've leaned on the wall behind you.
I see you, Baby John.

lines.zh: 你翻遍口袋，找的是钥匙吧。
lines.en: You're digging through your pockets. The key, right?
Sit down. I won't ask twice.

lines.zh: 昨晚敲门的那三下，是你。
lines.en: Those three knocks last night were you.
One bite, from a feral pup.
Not quite what I pictured.
This debt, I'll carve on my teeth.
This one I won't let slide.
Like a needle turning under my skin.
Next time I strike first. No waiting.
So this is what being struck feels like.

lines.zh: 叫不出来，只能低低地哼。
lines.en: I can't cry out, only hum low.
Doesn't hurt. I lied just now.

lines.zh: 我个子小，跑得比成体快。
lines.en: I'm small, and faster than the grown ones.
Pain — so this is what it feels like.
My legs shake, but I'm still up.
Put it on the ground and step back.
You dropped something.

lines.zh: 野生的我，比圈养的更急。
lines.en: Wild me is more impatient.
What is that? So bright.

lines.zh: 我野惯了，看见吃的就上。
lines.en: Feral as I am, food means a lunge.

lines.zh: 那点甜味，让我迈不开腿。
lines.en: That sweetness stops my legs.
Your name for one bite.
It's sweetness. I was mistaken.
It hums in your hand.
One for one. Deal?
You said sorry. I nodded.
I try to call, and the sound falls apart.
Your heart is racing.
Try that again.

lines.zh: 我退了半格，你最好也退。
lines.en: I took half a step back. You should too.
I slide along the baseboard, sideways.
So warm I took half a step back.

lines.zh: 这走廊太窄，谁都躲不开。
lines.en: This hall is too narrow. No one can dodge.
Two steps back. One more.
Through my hide, your warmth lingers.

lines.zh: 野生的小约翰也会咬人。
lines.en: Even a wild child John bites.

lines.zh: 我闻到你怕我，这味道真好。
lines.en: I smell that you fear me; lovely.
I've practiced touching you gently.
We are not alone anymore.

lines.zh: 我们幼体成群，最多十五只。
lines.en: We young come in packs of up to fifteen.
Walk on. I'll follow without a sound.
You have been alone too, yes?

lines.zh: 我跑得快，可我还咬不死你。
lines.en: I'm fast, but I can't kill you yet.
Don't cry. Just lean here.
Stand under the lamp. Don't move.
A thread still runs through its hole.
Pick it up and it's not lost.
I counted them: seven in all.
Small enough to pinch, hide in my mouth.
I found it at the bottom of the steps.
Held long enough, it turns as cold as me.
My fingerprints are on it.
Hold out your hand and I'll give it back.
This shadow is almost mine.
I bend fast. You won't see it.

lines.zh: 野性还没被磨掉，别靠近。
lines.en: The wildness is still in me. Stay back.
This time I won't lose you.

lines.zh: 你转头的那下，我贴近了门框。
lines.en: When you turned, I slipped against the door frame.
Pressed to the wall, I hear you coming.
I open my mouth and there are two rows.
I can't get these words out right.
You'll go left. I already know.

lines.zh: 你鞋底的泥，和脚印一样。
lines.en: The mud on your shoes matches the tracks.

lines.zh: 野生的幼体，牙已经长了。
lines.en: A feral cub — the teeth already grew in.
The scent matches. It's you.

lines.zh: 我还没长出成年那张脸。
lines.en: I haven't grown the adult face yet.
This time I'm not letting go
You're holding your breath. I can tell.

lines.zh: 小脚掌踩在地板上，轻一点。
lines.en: Little feet on the floorboards — step lighter.
Wet prints, not yet dry.
Fear mixed in your sweat. Easy to tell.
One step heavy, one step light.
The wildness isn't worn out of me — don't reach out
No hurry. Dawn is far off.
I'm still behind you, keeping pace.
In the lamplight, you show first.
The wardrobe door caught your coat.
You'll hit that door first.
Feral young, and my teeth are sharp.
One bare foot. You won't run far.
Three steps. I've counted carefully.
Short breath in, long breath out.
Past the corner, only I remain.
Around that corner, it's you walking.
No window on that wall.

lines.zh: 胸口一鼓一瘪，我都看着。
lines.en: Your chest pumps. I'm watching.
You forgot to turn off the light — I saw.

lines.zh: 幼体的第二张皮，也挺饿。
lines.en: The second skin of this young one is hungry too.
A line of light still leaks under the door.
You run three; I walk one.
I'll sit and wait for you to come out.
I bite your hem and will not let go.

lines.zh: 别动，别出声，我还没长牙。
lines.en: Keep still and quiet; my teeth are not grown.

lines.zh: 我这两张嘴，一起咬下去。
lines.en: Both my mouths bite down together.
Palm up. Don't clench it.
Both mouths bite down at once.
Close your eyes. Shorter than a blink.
Do not make me do that twice.
Raise it overhead where I can reach.
My hand can reach you now.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，和其他幼体不同。
lines.en: My face is not like the other young.
Count to three, then I stop waiting.

lines.zh: 喘气声在走廊里回来回去。
lines.en: Your breathing bounces down the hall.

lines.zh: 我也不想，可牙自己动了。
lines.en: I didn't mean to, but my teeth moved on their own.
Fingertips first. Teeth after.
Once my hand's on you, it won't let go.
My bite is precise. Nothing else.
I'll blink first. Look closely.
That small sound in the woods is me.
I stand in the doorway, blocking the light.
Footsteps in the grass.
Standing in the light, you're easy to see.
Fifteen of us huddled. Not cold.
It's stuck in the door frame.
The hinge made one small sound.
The floor by the bed's foot. Perfect.
I am back; I remember this place.

lines.zh: 这屋子里，就你一个活人。
lines.en: In this house, only you breathe.
When it darkens, I am here.
That breathing. It is mine.
Under the eaves, I too can be patient.

lines.zh: 我从墙缝里挤出半个身子。
lines.en: Half my body squeezes through the wall.

lines.zh: 空气里有点甜，是你的汗。
lines.en: The air's a little sweet. It's your sweat.
The name doesn't matter. The face does.
Slow enough that you think no one follows.

lines.zh: 换个模样，我还是那只幼崽。
lines.en: Different look, same young one.
Same wall as before.
Flames crawl up my sleeve.
The ground is harder than I thought.
The bubbles rise without a sound.
The blast rings in my ears.
Something went in.

lines.zh: 魔法在骨头里响，像敲钟。
lines.en: Magic rings in my bones like a bell.

lines.zh: 皮贴在骨头上，一按就凹。
lines.en: Skin on bone; press it and it sinks.
Touch my fingertip and a spark jumps.

lines.zh: 虚空里听不见我的叫声。
lines.en: In the void, my call can't be heard.
